# Pull Request: Insight Journal Blog Application

## 1. Summary

Implement a responsive, single-page blog application served by Express. Visitors
can browse articles and open full details; users can create posts with a
content-based summary saved in browser localStorage.

## 2. Changes Made

- Added a blog listing and article detail view with seeded example posts.
- Added a create-blog dialog with required title and content fields, trimming,
  length validation, and visible validation errors.
- Added deterministic summary generation based on article content; summaries
  are saved with blog records.
- Added localStorage persistence, saved-data shape checks, and user-facing
  storage error notices.
- Built responsive layouts and keyboard-operable blog selection.
- Served the static application through the existing Node.js and Express
  scaffold.

## 3. Test Evidence

- `npm.cmd start` — application started and listened on port 3000.
- `GET http://localhost:3000` — returned HTTP 200.
- Response content — contained `Insight Journal`.
- Blog listing, creation, and summary generation — reviewed in the
  implementation.
- `npm.cmd test` — executed successfully; the script reports that no automated
  tests are configured.

## 4. Known Limitations

- Blog data is local to the current browser profile and is not shared across
  devices or users.
- Summary generation is deterministic and local; it does not use an AI model or
  third-party AI service.
- The create workflow has no authentication and is not an access-control
  boundary.
- The create dialog does not trap keyboard focus while open.
- Automated tests are not configured, and the under-three-second page-load
  target has not been measured.
- The existing README describes summaries as AI-generated; align that wording
  with the local deterministic implementation before merging if that README
  change is included.

- [ ] Verify the responsive layout at desktop and mobile widths.

## 6. Changelog

- Added responsive blog browsing and article details.
- Added validated blog creation and localStorage persistence.
- Added deterministic article-summary generation and storage error handling.
- Added verification evidence; no automated test suite is configured.
